For each query, context_builder.build_context() returns the ranked, non-shuffled 'sources' (text-unit) table local search feeds the LLM; each text-unit short_id -> TextUnit.id == document.id -> document.title -> obs id; top-20 unique obs ids ranked; recall@k = |relevantObsIds ∩ top-k| / |relevantObsIds| averaged over 20 queries (empty relevant => 1.0).
note: GraphRAG local search returns a small, entity-focused context (1-5 source text-units per query here), so recall@5 == recall@10 == recall@20 (fewer than 5 docs are ever retrieved). This is a genuine property of GraphRAG's graph/entity retrieval paradigm, not a truncation bug: probing top_k_mapped_entities 10->30->60 only grows sources 3->7->9 (entity-matching limited, NLP entities sparse on short obs texts), and token budget (12000) was not the limiter.
